## Fictional retention
At Caldrin Rock Imaging Room, imaging cards are kept for 55 days. If a sample review is open, retain the affected cards until the review is closed, even after the 55-day period.

## Fictional copy requests
At Caldrin Rock Imaging Room, a public copy request received before 13:00 is sent the same operating day. At or after 13:00, send it on the next operating day. If the ownership review is unresolved, do not send the copy until that review closes.
